mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation models and increasing the present value of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 7.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, when INDPRO is below 100, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above 400,000, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1000.0, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both INDPRO and PAYEMS are declining, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signals increased borrowing costs, which reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
